purpose: Pinned source-built Godot 4.7.2 physics backend for macOS ARM64, Windows x86-64, Android ARM64 and single-threaded WebAssembly. Full original-game parity remains unverified.

engine_api.regeneration: Run the exact evaluated engine with --headless --dump-extension-api in verification/tools/engine-api-4.7.2.

box2d_fixture_patch.purpose: Synchronize only the edited fixture's broad-phase bounds after local geometry baking; preserve fixture/contact identity and schedule next-step pair creation.

build_requirements: SCons 4 or later and Python 3.8 or later.
macOS: Xcode command-line tools; platform tool selects clang++ (/usr/bin/clang++ with the supplied PATH).

Windows: verified with free Microsoft Build Tools 2022, MSVC v143 (14.44.35207) and Windows SDK. Select the explicit vcvars64.bat and msvc_version=14.3 shown above; automatic discovery selected an incomplete Community installation on the verification machine.
Android: approved official NDK 28.1.13356709 (r28b). Native ARM64 ELF LOAD alignment is 16KB; matching Godot template supplies libc++_shared.so.
Web: Emscripten on PATH; exercised with 6.0.13, single-threaded wasm32, official extension-enabled Godot 4.7.2 Web templates.
The exact engine API file above must already exist; SConstruct selects it by default. A custom_api_file=<absolute-path> argument can explicitly override it.
changes: Use matching godot-cpp 10 and the evaluated Godot 4.7.2 API, including current virtual hashes and real_t scalar signatures.
Register server implementation classes as internal extension classes.
Implement required direct-body collision layer/mask access, contact-local velocity, collider object lookup and default force integration.
Honor the one-way direction argument in body-shape state, solver filtering and motion queries.

Build two-point convex inputs, SegmentShape2D and ConcavePolygonShape2D endpoint pairs as actual two-sided Box2D edges; transform edges without adding artificial polygon thickness or closing disconnected segments.
Release owned template shapes and temporary conversion buffers.
Use one Godot world unit per original Unity metre, with original Box2D slop, polygon radius, sleeping and speed limits; camera and resource scaling preserve pixel presentation.
Accumulate central forces with ApplyForceToCenter rather than converting them to immediate impulses that a subsequent velocity assignment erases.
Maintain fixture shape indices after removal, destroy fixtures through owned handles, reference-count logical sensor shape pairs, and detach space/query lists before object destruction.
Reset pending monitor events by observer category and re-register existing overlap pairs when callbacks change, without dispatching null callbacks.
Use radius-aware stationary query/shape overlap instead of moving-sweep TOI's reduced separation target; preserve polygon-skin sensor contact semantics without changing moving sweeps.

Use fixture body's world transform once in shape queries: fixture vertices already contain their collider-local translation/rotation, so applying the saved local transform again displaces terrain fixtures.
Synchronize only an edited fixture's proxy bounds after local geometry baking, preserving fixture/contact identity and scheduling new broad-phase pairs.
Create BODY_MODE_STATIC as b2_staticBody, matching subsequent set_mode behavior and avoiding false kinematic velocity when static boss geometry moves.
Scale circle/capsule end-cap radius using absolute uniform scale, including reflected actors; keep circle centers and single-fixture synchronization unchanged.
Refilter existing owned fixtures when collision layer/mask actually changes, so stationary overlapping bodies enter/leave contacts without moving or rebuilding fixture identity.
remaining_upstream_limitations: No double-precision Box2D backend; evaluate precision=single only.
No edge-versus-edge contact manifold in Box2D.
Convex polygons are limited to the configured b2_maxPolygonVertices (64).
Circle/capsule skewing, thread safety and cross-platform determinism are not supplied by the upstream adapter.
Shape query transforms do not scale template geometry; bake scale into query shapes and pass rotation/translation-only transforms.
Custom per-shape solver bias is unsupported and already warns.
Existing body contacts-reported depth threshold setters/getters do not implement filtering.
Existing omit-force-integration state is stored but is not consumed by the upstream Box2D force step; custom integration requiring omitted automatic forces is unsupported.
Existing concave packed-float data input is not implemented; use PackedVector2Array endpoint pairs.
